TI.P: Judgment of the Court of First Instance(Single Judge)

INDEX.KEYWORD: Posting to a new place of employment

OBJECT.P: annulment of the Commission's decision refusing to grant the applicant, first, an installation allowance in a sum equivalent to two months' basic salary and, second, daily subsistence allowances.

DECISION.P: The action is dismissed. The parties are ordered to bear their own costs.

TXT.KEYWORD: Entitlement to the equivalent of a second month's basic salary for an official entitled to the household allowance
Change in place of residence of the official's family, arising directly from the official's obligation to reside in the place where he is employed

NP.P: (Staff Regulations, Art. 20, Annex VII, Art. 5(1) and (2))

NP.TXT: The entitlement to the equivalent of a second month's basic salary, provided for by way of the installation allowance by the first subparagraph of Article 5(1) of Annex VII to the Staff Regulations, in the case of an official who is entitled to the household allowance simply reflects the taking into account of the expenses imposed on the family of the official appointed or transferred to a new place of employment by the change in place of residence which he is obliged to make in order to comply with the residence requirement laid down by Article 20 of the Staff Regulations.
NP.P: For entitlement to that increase to be recognised, the change in the family's place of residence must therefore be a direct result of the official's obligation to reside in the place where he is employed.

NP.TXT: The purpose of the daily subsistence allowance is to compensate for the expenses and inconvenience resulting from the fact that a servant of the Communities is obliged, by reason of the precarious nature of his employment relationship with his institution, to move and to establish a provisional residence in the place where he is employed while maintaining, also on a provisional basis, his previous residence in a place where he has his centre of interests.
